messages:
zoe_sales: Quick sync: Halo POC intermittently fails parsing function-call JSON. Sometimes response has stray control bytes after the JSON -> client parser errors. They also hit a couple of 429s during ramp. They want Dedicated pricing and SQ confirmation (HSM/KMS, EU residency). Can eng & security triage?

matt_eng: can you paste a redacted stream chunk + headers? model variant?

zoe_sales: redacted chunk:
```
{"tool":"meta_extract","out":{"items":[{"id":"100","title":"Gadget"}]}}
\x00\x01\n
parse error at pos 198
```
Headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tool-1.0-q4`, `x-client-id: halo-9`

pat_oncall: 429s likely from client-side concurrency. Endpoint? workers?

zoe_sales: /v1/stream, 10 parallel workers.

sandeep_ml: q4 path can emit small binary footers when a streaming flush races with batching. We should sanitize trailing non-UTF8 bytes in the stream assembler, and provide an optional fallback wrapper so clients always get valid JSON.

matt_eng: plan: add sanitizer to drop non-utf8 suffix; if bytes were stripped and route flag `tool_stream_fallback=base64` is set, emit {"_rw_tool_malformed":true,"raw_b64":"..."}. I'll open a small PR.

cam_security: SQ: customer asks about HSM-backed keys and logs in eu-west-1 for 5 years. Private supports customer KMS/HSM. Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-west-1 for enterprise contracts (with KMS addendum). 5-year retention usually done via export/archival add-on; I'll draft formal response.

ryan_salesops: ballpark Dedicated for their estimated load (35k tokens/day sustained) is ~Uk/mo; reserved min 4 GPUs. I'll loop finance for exact numbers and an accelerated quote.

build-bot: [ci 2100.1] stream-sanitizer branch built. unit tests: ✅ integration tests: ✅. staging deploy queued.

matt_eng: canary plan: add halo-9 to canary routing and bump burst tokens temporarily for repro. Pat, can you do that?

pat_oncall: added halo-9 to canary and increased burst limit to 200 for 4 hours. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/integrations/halo-9/streams.

zoe_sales: customer will repro tonight 19:00 UTC. If we can show clean JSON + stable QPS they'll sign. Please update here after canary. Thanks!
